11860|ae16ea2b.name: Maggran Earthbinder
11860|ae16ea2b.text: I am afraid that I am no longer gentle or humble. Age and countless battles have hardened my skin and soul. Perhaps that is why Cairne assigned me to Sun Rock Retreat... the gentle winds and warm sun does ease the pain.

12196|7161de72.name: Innkeeper Kaylisk
12196|7161de72.text: If we are to make these new lands ours then we must have places to rest our battle weary bodies. Lay your axe by the fire and share the stories of your mighty battles.

12696|f1d5ba87.name: Senani Thunderheart
12696|f1d5ba87.text: Do you hear the call of the hunt, $c?  You must listen closely, but the call comes from deep within you.  It comes from deep within all of us.

12724|39b67c2e.name: Pixel
12724|39b67c2e.text: This forest can be confusing! Be careful out there.

13417|1605f087.name: Sagorne Creststrider
13417|1605f087.text: The spirits have guided you to me. How may I be of service?

16227|c5ceacbe.name: Bragok
16227|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

248201|5de3438e.name: Pawani
248201|5de3438e.text: Greetings, friend! I have an ample supply of leather and hides, and I know a few techniques I might be willing to share. Interested in doing business?

256386|6a190ff9.name: Dokimi
256386|6a190ff9.text: We've had trouble with shipments going missing across Azeroth. If you find any, I'd appreciate if you could return them to me.

3309|2f8d506f.name: Karus
3309|2f8d506f.text: Besides the Grunts outside, my brothers and I fought at the battle of Hyjal. Any who seek to steal from the bank must face us first.

3310|cc0cf280.name: Doras
3310|cc0cf280.text: You haven't lived until you've looked down on the world from the back of a wind rider.

3332|51d936f4.name: Lumak
3332|51d936f4.text: Fish so delicious. You come learn fish? Eat fish? Mmmmm...

3341|bdd68929.name: Gann Stonespire
3341|bdd68929.text:
I walk this road alone, seeking ways to defend my honor and rid this land of our enemies.

What can I do for you, $N?

3365|0443423e.name: Karolek
3365|0443423e.text: The twists and turns of Orgrimmar are designed to thwart invaders. Can you imagine how quickly one of those puny gnomes would get lost in here? Ha! If it was lucky, I'd track it down and keep it as a pet.

3387|da8a5dad.name: Jorn Skyseer
3387|da8a5dad.text: Although we call this land the Barrens, to one who knows where to look this place teems with life.

3412|d0fc10c2.name: Nogg
3412|d0fc10c2.text: If there were just a few more hours in a day...

3430|d6fdd5ef.name: Mangletooth
3430|d6fdd5ef.text:
You have <snort> aided Mangletooth more than I would have dreamed, $r.

Thank you.

As long as I remain a captive here, you may bring me blood shards from the Bristleback quilboar and I will bless you with Agamaggan's power.

3433|4ec00f6f.name: Tatternack Steelforge
3433|4ec00f6f.text:
The Warchief has instructed me to study all kinds of weapons and armor. He has sent me here to the hub of both the tauren and orc cultures in the Barrens to meet as many travelers as possible, and to learn about the cultures of the Barrens.

He feels there's something to be learned from even the most pathetic of cultures... like the quilboar or centaur.

3442|c0ad1190.name: Sputtervalve
3442|c0ad1190.text: Lots to do, lots to do! The Union's given us deadlines and they're not the sort you want to miss!

3446|36457281.name: Mebok Mizzyrix
3446|36457281.text:
Yes yes yes!  You're just the $r I'm looking for!

Sit!  We have much to discuss!!

3615|ddd7878b.name: Devrak
3615|ddd7878b.text: My wind riders are trained to fly quickly through the hot Barrens air.

4312|c5ceacbe.name: Tharm
4312|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

5811|e65e27ca.name: Kamari
5811|e65e27ca.text: I have nothing more to teach you. Talk to Karolek if you wish to further your leatherworking skills.

1069-complete.name: Mebok Mizzyrix
1069-complete.text:
You got them!  Thank you!

I'll have these sent to Dizzywig and get them shipped to Booty Bay.  I can already taste the profits!

Here is your cut, $N.  I couldn't have made this deal without you.
1069-complete.title: Deepmoss Spider Eggs

1069-progress.name: Mebok Mizzyrix
1069-progress.text: Did you get the eggs, $N?  I already made a shipping deal with Wharfmaster Dizzywig!
1069-progress.title: Deepmoss Spider Eggs

1087-accept.name: Braelyn Firehand
1087-accept.text:
You cannot imagine the hatred I possess for this wretched land. The ilk of Cenarius and the kaldorei druids at the peak employ their pathetic powers to stifle the flow of magic, even so far south of their pathetic holdings... their beloved forests.

Would that I could return to Jaedenar and exult in the flow of magic, but my master will not allow me to return until my work is done.

I have no doubt you love the night elves and their allies as little as I. Aid me, and both our ends might be satisfied.
1087-accept.title: Cenarius' Legacy

1093-accept.name: Ziz Fizziks
1093-accept.text:
Terrible what the Venture Company has done here, eh? What were they thinking? Goblin company hiring a gnome!

Lucky for me, Sputtervalve knows a genius when he sees one. Hired me just after I'd been kicked out!

Tells me they built some enormous woodcutting machine, and Sput' wants me to steal the plans for him. Unfortunately, Gerenzo--bloody gnome--wants me dead on sight... maybe you could steal the plans for me? You should be able to find them on one of their operators.
1093-accept.title: Super Reaper 6000

1093-complete.name: Ziz Fizziks
1093-complete.text:
Hey, is that what I think it is? Great!

Now, let's see. Ugh... how am I supposed to understand this stuff... can't figure out the way gnomes think. Lemme tell you, I'm surprised they could build the wheel, let alone those flying machines they like so much.
1093-complete.title: Super Reaper 6000

1093-progress.name: Ziz Fizziks
1093-progress.text: Did you find those plans? I'm eager to impress the new boss. Hopefully, once he's convinced of my loyalty--well, as much as he can be convinced... goblin's honor, you know?--he'll feel comfortable making use of my rather impressive genius.
1093-progress.title: Super Reaper 6000

1094-accept.name: Ziz Fizziks
1094-accept.text:
This envelope has all the information I was able to snatch as they booted me out the door... Venture Company internal documents, some manuals, technical things... Oh, and of course the Super Reaper 6000 blueprints.

Sputtervalve has taken up residence at Ratchet in the Barrens. Shouldn't have much trouble finding him, he's a little green fellow.
1094-accept.title: Further Instructions

1094-complete.name: Sputtervalve
1094-complete.text:
Fizziks, eh? Can't say I trust him, but this information seems good enough. What I wouldn't give to have the Venture Company out of my hair.

They do come up with some good machines though... I can't deny that we've benefited from using some of the improvements they've devised.
1094-complete.title: Further Instructions

1094-progress.name: Sputtervalve
1094-progress.text: Hello there! How can I help you?
1094-progress.title: Further Instructions

1095-accept.name: Sputtervalve
1095-accept.text:
The matter of this gnome that has been hired by the Venture Company has caused a bit of a stir in Undermine. The trade princes do not approve of Razdunk's consorting with this Gerenzo.

Riddlevox has asked me to take care of the problem, and I'm sure he was instructed to do so by one or more of the trade princes. Of course, the Director didn't tell me that. Let's just say I have a hunch.

Whatever the case, Gerenzo must be removed, and it would be a fitting test to have Fizziks take care of him.
1095-accept.title: Further Instructions

1153-accept.name: Tatternack Steelforge
1153-accept.text:
$C, you have done well in helping me in the past. The warchief is pleased thus far with what I've accomplished, and asks me to continue with renewed determination. My honor dictates that I give you proper recognition to the warchief for all you have done, but first I would ask you for your help again.

Travelers recently came from the south from a place called Thousand Needles. There they killed a kobold who had an unusual ore sample, but they would not sell it. I want a sample of that ore to examine.
1153-accept.title: A New Ore Sample

1483-complete.name: Ziz Fizziks
1483-complete.text:
I thought those Venture Company higher-ups were slave drivers, but then I met Sputtervalve, the cruelest of them all!

Ha! Though it's better than being out of a job, I suppose... Or worse, working with that Gerenzo. If you're here to help, I've got something for you to do.
1483-complete.title: Ziz Fizziks

2841-accept.name: Nogg
2841-accept.text:
Gnome technology - two years ago its most common use was as a punch line. Times certainly have changed. Now they've got a new rig built that's better than all our shredder models combined. I need the blueprints, $N!

Unfortunately, the plans are locked away in a safe near Mekgineer Thermaplugg. To make matters worse, the combination to the safe is only known by Mekgineer Thermaplugg.

Do whatever you have to do to get that combination, $N. Then crack open that safe and bring back those blueprints!
2841-accept.title: Rig Wars

3923-complete.name: Rilli Greasygob
3923-complete.text:
What's this?  Why, it's a samophlange!  Where did you get this thing?  Have you been poking around the Venture Company holdings in the Barrens?

You must be very brave, or very stupid.
3923-complete.title: Rilli Greasygob

3923-progress.name: Rilli Greasygob
3923-progress.text: Mind your head!  I don't want it to get in the way of my work!
3923-progress.title: Rilli Greasygob

3924-accept.name: Rilli Greasygob
3924-accept.text:
I think I can fix the samophlange, but I'm going to need the user's manual first.  When I was in the Venture Company I had a rival, Boss Copperplug, who hoarded the secrets of the samophlange, giving out small bits of knowledge on the device to those he trusted.  I wasn't one of the trusted few...

Boss Copperplug used to stay at the Boulder Lode Mine in northeastern Barrens.  Get the manual from him, and if he's given pages from it to anyone, you'll have to collect them too.
3924-accept.title: Samophlange Manual

4542-accept.name: Brave Moonhorn
4542-accept.text:
Brave traveler, the centaurs have increased their attacks in this area. Freewind Post must know about this renewed harassment immediately! Seek Cliffwatcher Longhorn at Freewind Post to the southeast and give him this urgent message.

Be warned, avoid the Grimtotem Clan nearby... they have been acting strange toward us lately.
4542-accept.title: Message to Freewind Post

5042-complete.name: Mangletooth
5042-complete.text:
If only Mangletooth were free to see you decimate those who betrayed him! <snort>

I thank you for destroying more of the Bristleback by gathering these shards. Please, continue to do so, and I will continue to aid you. <snort>
5042-complete.title: Agamaggan's Strength

5042-progress.name: Mangletooth
5042-progress.text:
I will need 4 blood shards if you wish Agamaggan's strength, $r.

Your foes will cower before your strength were you to be given this blessing. <snort>

The Razormane's greatest warriors are infused with such power!
5042-progress.title: Agamaggan's Strength

6382-complete.name: Senani Thunderheart
6382-complete.text:
Welcome to the new frontier, $N.  Ashenvale is a land of opportunity, one where a young $c like yourself is able to find boundless chances to prove their mettle.  Look around the outpost here, and be sure to travel out to the Zoram Strand, as the Horde has another outpost there as well.

Your presence here tells me that you've come to learn more about the hunt.  Listen close, and I will gladly share with you what you need to know.
6382-complete.title: The Ashenvale Hunt

6383-complete.name: Senani Thunderheart
6383-complete.text:
There are three legendary creatures that make up the Ashenvale Hunt; you may seek them and test yourself against their cunning and might.  In the process, you will hopefully learn something about yourself.  The creatures are: the bear Ursangous, the nightsaber cat Shadumbra, and the hippogryph Sharptalon.

The creatures of the Ashenvale Hunt are powerful, and you may find that you'll need aid in bringing them down.  If you should best them, bring me proof of your deed.
6383-complete.title: The Ashenvale Hunt

6441-accept.name: Pixel
6441-accept.text:
Heya! I've been traveling through Ashenvale, heading towards Ratchet, and decided to make a stop here at Splintertree. I'm always looking for an opportunity, and it seems that satyr horns are in high demand in Ratchet these days.

After asking around here, it seems that the satyrs in Night Run, Satyrnaar, and Xavian all have the type of horns I am looking for. I'm no match for those satyrs... but you look like you might be!

Tell you what, you collect the horns for me and I'll make it worth your time.
6441-accept.title: Satyr Horns

6503-accept.name: Kuray'bin
6503-accept.text:
We received reports that Ashenvale outrunners left Silverwing Outpost not long ago, and now sneak near our territories in the forest.  We don't want them gathering intelligence on our defenses!

Sneak through the forests south of our post here and east of the Alliance outpost of Silverwing.  Find and slay the outrunners, then return to me.
6503-accept.title: Ashenvale Outrunners

6503-complete.name: Kuray'bin
6503-complete.text:
Very good, $N.  Your hunting skills are impressive...

The loss of those outrunners helps blind the Alliance, and when they lack intelligence they are less likely to launch attacks.
6503-complete.title: Ashenvale Outrunners

6504-accept.name: Gurda Ragescar
6504-accept.text:
I just picked up this shredder from Ratchet and I was on my way back to the Warsong Lumber Camp, where I am supposed to be on duty. I was given a manual on how to operate the shredder, but on the trip back, a huge gust of wind blew it from my hands. The pages went everywhere, and all I was left with was the cover.

The pages could be just about anywhere by now, I suppose... but I don't know how to use the shredder without them! Will you find them for me?
6504-accept.title: The Lost Pages

6546-complete.name: Warsong Outrider
6546-complete.text: Take my update to Kadrak. Swiftly, $N.
6546-complete.title: Warsong Outrider Update

6546-progress.name: Warsong Outrider
6546-progress.text:
Much danger lies along this path, $N. You'd do best to remember this while traveling in these lands. The threat of the alliance is quite near.

We are faced by enemies on all fronts. The satyr are a formidable and prevalent force in eastern Ashenvale.  I have also discovered that the naga have taken over a large area of the land of Azshara.

It's good to see that we are still bolstering our numbers -- be ready for what lies ahead, $N.
6546-progress.title: Warsong Outrider Update

6547-complete.name: Warsong Scout
6547-complete.text: Let Kadrak know of the success we have had here holding off the night elves. Our plans are going well.
6547-complete.title: Warsong Scout Update

6547-progress.name: Warsong Scout
6547-progress.text:
Keep an eye out, $r. The elves are often hiding in the shadows...

We must always be watching. We have worked very hard to claim this land, and the elves are looking for a chance to take it from us.

I assume you have my next orders from Kadrak?
6547-progress.title: Warsong Scout Update

6571-accept.name: Locke Okarr
6571-accept.text:
We are in short supply of a few items at the Warsong lumber camp!

Pixel at Splintertree Post has our shipment of saw blades. It'll take a trip to Booty Bay to pick up a crate of axes from Wharfmaster Lozgil.

Our shipment of oil and rope will be more difficult. The rope was pilfered by the Thistlefur and Foulweald furbolgs, and the satyrs intercepted the delivery of the oil and are now using it for detestable rituals in Night Run, Satyrnaar, and Xavian!

Can you help me?
6571-accept.title: Warsong Supplies

6581-progress.name: Pixel
6581-progress.text:
Direct from Ratchet, the Warsong saw blades! Yep, I have them right here.

..But what sort of payment do you have for me? You can't just take them, you know! My time isn't cheap!

What I really need is a good gun to carry with me on my travels. A girl's gotta protect herself, you know? There's a gun I really like that I'm sure an engineer would have no problem making.

So, if you bring me a deadly blunderbuss, I'll give you the saw blade shipment. Do we have a deal?
6581-progress.title: Warsong Saw Blades

846-complete.name: Gann Stonespire
846-complete.text:
I see you are quite industrious, $c.

No doubt we shall soon have a fitting surprise for those dwarves.
846-complete.title: Revenge of Gann

846-progress.name: Gann Stonespire
846-progress.text:
I see you are back, $N.

While Khazgorm's death might delay the digging in my ancestral lands some, it will by no means bring a total end to the destruction.

The Keep at Bael Modan is an increasing military threat. Built to defend the dig site, it is now poised for offensive force as well.

If you have the ingredients I requested, I can fashion a charge that will make the hasty dwarves reconsider their actions here in the Barrens.
846-progress.title: Revenge of Gann

849-accept.name: Gann Stonespire
849-accept.text:
Following Khazgorm's plans it should be no problem to fashion an explosive charge

Ah, there we go.

Now, $N, I am going to entrust you with a special task. Take this explosive stick and use it to blow up the flying machine at Bael Modan.

Not only is the flying machine a key part of the site's infrastructure it also serves as a weapon of war. More importantly it is an icon of power and an insult to the memory of my tribe.

Make me proud by completing this heroic task and you shall be rewarded.
849-accept.title: Revenge of Gann

849-complete.name: Gann Stonespire
849-complete.text: You have done well, $N! May you be revered in Thunder Bluff as a defender of sacred tauren lands and a champion of the lost tribe.
849-complete.title: Revenge of Gann

857-accept.name: Lamal
857-accept.text:
The power was mine! In my very hands! And I want it back! Back I say!

Those dirty excavators uncovered it... so beautiful it was. Deemed the Tear of the Moons, it was the first great discovery we made at Bael Modan.

It should have been mine! Mine I say!

General Twinbraid grew jealous of the power it gave me. He locked it away in the Keep. Called it cursed, he did! The fool!

Others wanted it and they had to be stopped! That bastard Twinbraid drove me off.

Now I want it back. Back I say!
857-accept.title: The Tear of the Moons

857-complete.name: Feegly the Exiled
857-complete.text: At last, the power is mine again! Mine I say!
857-complete.title: The Tear of the Moons

857-progress.name: Feegly the Exiled
857-progress.text: Where is the Tear of the Moons? I need it now! Need I say!
857-progress.title: The Tear of the Moons

873-accept.name: Mahren Skyseer
873-accept.text:
The grand Isha Awak is lord of these waters.  Great is his strength, and solemn his pride.  The humans on the coast fear him, for he has consumed many of their number.

But I do not fear him.  I am grateful he is here.  He is a worthy challenge, and honorable prey.

If you are ready, then swim out and search for Isha Awak, the Deep Doom.

His spirit dwells in his heart, and to hear its beat is to know your fate.
873-accept.title: Isha Awak

873-complete.name: Mahren Skyseer
873-complete.text:
You now are one with Isha Awak, $N.  His spirit is with you.  He lurks in your eyes...

Eyes that, one day, will learn to see.
873-complete.title: Isha Awak

874-accept.name: Jorn Skyseer
874-accept.text:
You have hunted the beasts of the Barrens.  Your spirit is strong.  But a hunter must always be prepared.  A true hunter can stalk prey down any path.  Mountains and swamps will not sway him.

Not even the sea.

Find my sister, Mahren.  She hunts the great water beasts along the coast.  She will be your teacher in their ways.

But be wary in your search for her, for the Barrens' coast is held by humans.
874-accept.title: Mahren Skyseer

874-complete.name: Mahren Skyseer
874-complete.text:
My brother sent you, did he?  Then you must have proven yourself to him.  If you have earned the respect of Jorn, then you have my respect as well.

Are you ready to tread farther down the hunter's path?
874-complete.title: Mahren Skyseer

907-complete.name: Jorn Skyseer
907-complete.text: It is good to see you return with proof of victory.  And it is good to know you have done so with your bones unbroken.
907-complete.title: Enraged Thunder Lizards

913-accept.name: Jorn Skyseer
913-accept.text:
The thunderhawk, $N, is a fierce beast.  It is time for you to face them.  You must find where it roams, and bring me its wings as proof of your successful hunt.

Do this, and your time with me will near its end.
913-accept.title: Cry of the Thunderhawk

913-complete.name: Jorn Skyseer
913-complete.text:
You, like the thunderhawk, should be proud.  You have bested every foe we set you before, and have done so with strength, courage and honor.

But your path, $N, continues.  In fact, you will find that true hunters forever strive, forever walk their path with the same pride you have shown me.

Now, it is time to move on.
913-complete.title: Cry of the Thunderhawk

913-progress.name: Jorn Skyseer
913-progress.text: Is it done? Have you slain the thunderhawk?
913-progress.title: Cry of the Thunderhawk

91904-progress.name: Dokimi
91904-progress.text: Another delivery! Fantastic. Set it over by the pile and we can discuss your compensation.
91904-progress.title: A Sealed Crate
